//  SYMBOLS: XAUUSD, BTCUSD, ETHUSD, USOIL (EURUSD switchable, OFF by default). Each method has its own magic number and limits:
//   1. PULLBACK  M5 / M15 / H1 : D1 + H4 trend agree, pull-back to the EMA20 (M15 also EMA50) and a strong close.
//   2. BREAKOUT  M15 / H1      : 20-candle breakout with a strong close, momentum candle, deep pull-back to the EMA50.
//   3. MEMORY    M15 / H1      : setups learnt on ALL data of the 5 symbols (kept only when positive in every era).
//                                ON by default (owner's choice). Honest note: on unseen years (walk-forward) the memory lost on
//                                every symbol; with the pause rule gold / BTC were about break-even. SHADOW = virtual trades only.
//  HISTORY TABLE: every situation (setup, H4, D1 EMA200, volatility, session) with its record from ALL the data of the 5 symbols
//                 (121,419 signals: gold 2006-2026, BTC 2015-2026, ETH 2020-2026, EURUSD 2005-2026, oil 2005-2026).
//   4. TREND     H4 / H1       : per-symbol entries that tested positive (gold 7, BTC 6, ETH 3 + 2 RANGE entries, oil 3, EURUSD 2).
//  EXIT: best per symbol (gold: half at 1R + stop to entry + trailing; BTC / ETH: step lock), H4 flip, trend points, time limit.
//  FILTERS: gold spread <= 6% of the stop and H4 must agree; BTC / ETH: no new trades in a wild market; news, session, spread.
//  LOTS: fixed per symbol; BTC by 0.5% risk; gold Pullback / Memory can be set to SMALL or OFF.
//  TELEGRAM: trader-style posts (no robot words), "setup loading" heads-up before entries, every update / exit as a reply to its
//  entry, honest promotions and real-result scoreboards, admin alerts + heartbeat + commands. PANEL: small, clean, with buttons.
//  CHART: clean drawings, candle patterns + trendlines only where they matter (auto-deleted).
//  HONEST NOTE: results come from an emulator on history - live results will differ. Run it on DEMO first.
//+------------------------------------------------------------------+
